name: trading-input-output-checklist
description: Artifact-level validation checklist for generated trading input components and order form input rows.
appliesTo: 代码/类型/价格/数量/金额

checks.question: Does the artifact instantiate a recognized trading input component structure?
checks.evidenceRequired: Component name, layer name, DOM/data attribute, or structure tree matching trading-input-component.json.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Are trading input containers 36px tall with 4px radius?
checks.evidenceRequired: Style, token, Figma measurement, or DOM measurement.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Do inputs use xzl/color/input/background, xzl/color/text/quaternary, and xzl/color/text/primary instead of raw colors?
checks.evidenceRequired: Token usage list or component style evidence.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Do disabled backgrounds, icons, and symbols apply 40% opacity?
checks.evidenceRequired: State style evidence.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Are required icons rendered as visible nodes rather than notes?
checks.evidenceRequired: Visible icon nodes, named layers, SVG children, or DOM elements.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: In the target standalone HTML, file://, or local static preview environment, are trading input icons actually visible after final browser rendering?
checks.evidenceRequired: Rendered evidence such as screenshot, pixel check, computed fill/stroke plus contrast, or equivalent proof showing non-zero icon bounds, visible fill/stroke/pixels, correct token color, and contrast against the input background.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Do all financial numeric runs inside trading inputs use 涨乐财富体, including numeric runs inside composite text?
checks.evidenceRequired: Text run/style evidence showing stock codes, prices, quantities, amounts, percentages, ratios, and other financial numbers use 涨乐财富体; composite values split name and numeric runs. For standalone HTML or local preview artifacts, evidence must include actual font availability/application, not only CSS font-family declarations.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: For standalone HTML or local preview artifacts, are required financial numeric fonts accessible from the rendered page and actually applied to numeric runs?
checks.evidenceRequired: Font asset exists under the prototype-accessible directory, @font-face uses a relative or served URL, and rendered/computed text for stock codes, prices, quantities, and amounts resolves to 涨乐财富体 / ZLCaiFuTi.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Are code input, dropdown input, numeric stepper input, and numeric stepper + dropdown value areas horizontally centered?
checks.evidenceRequired: Layout/style evidence showing the middle value area is centered and not visually offset by left empty or right icon zones.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Do required trading input icons use assets/icons/* or equivalent approved icon component assets instead of hand-drawn approximations?
checks.evidenceRequired: Asset references such as assets/icons/plus-outlined.svg or equivalent shared icon component bindings; standalone HTML may inline approved SVG content.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.question: Do trading input icons keep required edge spacing?
checks.evidenceRequired: Final rendered measurement evidence, not only spacing tokens or CSS padding values: code/dropdown right icon is 8px from right edge; numeric stepper minus is 8px from left edge and plus is 8px from right edge; numeric stepper + dropdown spacing matches the component rule.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.evidenceRequired: Rendered measurement or equivalent proof showing dropdown/code right icons and numeric stepper plus icons are 8px from the input container's right edge, and numeric stepper minus icons are 8px from the left edge.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the trading-input component template and references/trading-inputs rules, then expose measurable structure, tokens, icon assets, and states in the artifact.

checks.evidenceRequired: Token/rendered evidence showing adjacent background layers use intentional dark tokens or inheritance, with no accidental white/light blocks around modules, inputs, fixed bars, or safe areas.
